Name: Retexture for Wizard
Author: quilb
Description:
I just wanted a more handsome wizard textures. So I made it.
This mod contains character xnb file and portrait xnb file.
If you need to use the marriage mod and you like this texture, please use my textures.

[Siv's Marriage Mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/366]
[Looking for Love (formerly Siv's Marriage Mod): https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3054]

But you can use it even if you do not have a marriage mode.


[Installation]
Drag and Drop  my "content' folder into your  "Stardew Valley" folder and merge textures.
***If you use Marriage mod, place it in the folder that contains the wizard texture. It's important.***



[Miscellaneous files]
I uploaded the file for the event. This is not an xnb file. It is a text file. For modder.
All scripts are in Korean, so you need to translate it into your language to use..
My English skills were not enough. So I can not translate scripts what the wizard is saying into English. I'm so sorry. 

You must copy all scripts contained in this file and paste it into your event xnb file to see the new events.
Probably you need a yaml translator to unzip the xnb file. (For Example: XNBExtract program)
"New event text file 1" scripts should be pasted into the 'Forest.XNB' file. (In "Content\Data\Events" folder)
"New event text file 2" scripts should be pasted into the 'WizardHouse.XNB' file. (In "Content\Data\Events" folder)
After you modify the event file, download 'all expression' file. (Miscellaneous files tap)


You can upload events created by modifying my txt files at will.
